title: Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras
summary: Bautista, Gabriel, Roiter, and Salmer\'on proved that every finite-dimensional representation-finite algebra over an algebraically closed field admits a multiplicative basis, in which products of basis elements are zero or basis elements. Outside characteristic two, they also proved that such an algebra is standard: its category of indecomposable modules is presented by its Auslander--Reiten quiver and mesh relations.
